text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I visited a nature park with Victoire Pisa
for a change of pace, but...

Um, what should I do...!
First, calm down—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Buena-san, whatever is the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ! ...Oh no, this child is—!
choice_data_list: A baby bird is on the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes, when I was passing by, this little one was chirping so loudly...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I-In times like this...
is it better to pick it up for them?
Or should I just leave it alone...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so that is why you were trying to look into
what would be best for this child, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's all right.
—Look, this little one may still be small, but its wings are growing in nicely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
They must be practicing leaving the nest.
That's why the mother birds are sure to be keeping watch nearby.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Practicing leaving the nest—
I see, what a relief...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If you'd like,
would you watch over it with me
until its parents come to pick it up?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*...! Thank goodness...
That little one made it safely home...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Parent and child snuggled close together...
So that is what a 'bond' is.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah—this is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa picks up an isolated section of fence.
It appears to be broken and disconnected
from the other fences...
choice_data_list: Should I let management know later?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
...Leaving it alone is best, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait! Would it be alright
if I made some emergency repairs to this fence...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? Pisa-san is fixing it...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I just...
I just can't bring myself to leave her alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even though she has friends around her... she's the only one left like this... It's like she's all alone.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right... It looks so lonely and isolated...
Um, I'll help too!
choice_data_list: (Their sheer kindness is resonating with each other...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And then, having finished emergency repairs on the fence,
Victoire Pisa and the others were looking for the
caretaker to explain the situation.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The agency staff mentioned that over this way...
Ah—

text_block_list.name: Nature Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
That's troublesome.
Guess I won't be able to use this for a while...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! The mountain trail is utterly ruined...!
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Nature Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there was a bit of a landslide.
Cleaning this up's gonna be a pain...
As you can see, the road is completely blocked.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um... would you mind if I helped
with the restoration?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to reconnect
this mountain trail just as it was!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait! No matter how you look at it,
you're pushing yourself way too hard, Pisa-san...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern.
Even so... I can't just leave it alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I believe this mountain trail
must have been walked by so many people."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying beautiful nature while surrounded by smiles
...what a wonderful road.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If this path is cut off...
my connection with everyone will disappear.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm asking for something unreasonable.
...However—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I don't want this precious bond... to be broken...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san... All for everyone's smiles...!
B-But...
trying to pave the way alone is too reckless...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I'll do it too.
If we do it together, I'm sure—we can connect it!

text_block_list.name: Nature Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
You guys are willing to go that far...!
Alright, I understand.
Just promise me you won't do anything reckless!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
I will pass on the torch, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Buena
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAAH!
—YAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Nature Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa...
It's getting cleared up in no time...!

text_block_list.name: Nature Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
"I can already walk again...!
Thank you both, you've saved me!
At this rate, I'll have it back in working order in no time!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, the pleasure is mine.
...I'm truly glad I was able to protect this connection.
choice_data_list: I think I might want to start connecting things too...
I think I might want to connect something too...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, the pleasure is mine.
...I'm truly glad I was able to protect this connection.
choice_data_list: I think I might want to start connecting things too...
I think I might want to connect something too...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
World-class, you say...? Hehe, certainly.
Buena-san is someone who can truly empathize
with and stay close to others, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, Pisa, it's thanks to you. Your warm kindness
has brought me to tears so many times.
choice_data_list: See? I knew it, you two really are world-class.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
In that case, I shall hold my head high for now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I think I might understand a little bit...
When I'm with Pisa-san, it makes me want
to connect lonely-looking things too~.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Isn't that simply because
the two of you are such kind people?
